title: Partite perfect matchings
statement: For natural numbers $q,k$, define a partite perfect matching to be a perfect matching code of index $(qk)/2$ satisfying the condition that every decoded edge joins vertices with unequal quotients upon division by $k$.
caveat: The decoding convention and the underlying perfect matching code construction are referenced but not included in the supplied definitions.
